raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute box size",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Element counts are specified, but no physical length scale is assigned to the voxel grid.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit cubic elements: box dimensions 40 × 20 × 8.",
        "Cubic elements of side 1/40: box dimensions 1 × 0.5 × 0.2."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 gives 40 × 20 × 8 elements; Fig. 3(a) has no dimensional labels. Sec. 3.4 specifies normalization of neural-network inputs."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Downward loading on the bottom edge of the free end",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The two arrows do not establish whether loading acts only at the corners or along the entire connecting edge.",
      "readings": [
        "Two equal downward point forces at the two bottom corners of the free end.",
        "A uniform downward line load along the complete bottom free-end edge, using consistent nodal loads.",
        "Equal downward nodal forces at all nine nodes along that edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 3(a) shows two downward arrows at opposite ends of the bottom free-end edge and one F label; Sec. 4.1 does not define the load distribution."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall force normalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical force magnitude or resultant-versus-per-node convention is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize the total downward resultant to one force unit.",
        "Apply one downward force unit at each loaded node."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 3(a) labels the loading F without a value; Sec. 4.1 supplies no magnitude. For a fixed loaded-node set and relative distribution, these conventions differ only by a common multiplier."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Validation target volume fraction V*",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The target volume fraction for Fig. 3 is not reported.",
      "readings": [
        "V* = 0.30 of the full box.",
        "V* = 0.40 of the full box.",
        "V* = 0.50 of the full box."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.5, Eq. (20), defines V* as an equality target; Sec. 4.1 and the Fig. 3 caption give no numerical value."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid modulus is symbolic and has no assigned value. Its common stiffness scaling affects compliance only when other stiffness ratios remain fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in consistent nondimensional units.",
        "E0 = 210 GPa, with the same relative residual stiffness."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2, Eq. (6), introduces E0; neither Sec. 3.2 nor Sec. 4.1 assigns its value."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Isotropy is specified, but Poisson's ratio is not.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.25.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 specifies isotropic material and eight-node hexahedral elements but gives no Poisson's ratio; Sec. 4.1 adds no material parameters."
    }
  ]
}
